tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Main content background (chat, pages). White by default — the corporate standard.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers, dialog footers, settings group backgrounds, source excerpts.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: User message bubble, hovered rows and nav items, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, composer, menus, dialogs, toasts — always with a line border and/or shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders — meets 3:1 on canvas and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token (≥12:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, timestamps, table secondary cells (≥5.5:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled-adjacent hints on canvas and surface-raised only (≥4.5:1 there).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: BenterAI blue sampled from the logo. Logo, spark motif, icons and large accents only — 3.99:1 on white, so never small body text in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, active nav text, citation markers, focus ring. Text use: on canvas, surface-subtle and brand-soft (≥5.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of primary buttons and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-strong / brand-hover fills (5.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, active toggle chips (web search on), selected Knowledge doc chip, citation pills.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Secondary star of the logo spark. Decorative only — cover, empty-state art, streaming indicator.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready / active status text and icons, on canvas, surfaces and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ready / active badge and toast background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending account, quota near limit, forced password change, on canvas, surfaces and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge, banner and toast background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed status, validation errors, destructive buttons and confirmations, on canvas, surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Failed badge, error banner and destructive dialog icon well.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Corporate navy app sidebar and the login brand panel. Pair with the reversed wordmark.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered nav item and chat row inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Selected nav item / current chat inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar, sidebar-hover and sidebar-active (≥10:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Group labels, timestamps and secondary text on sidebar and sidebar-hover (≥6:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active-item indicator bar and icons on sidebar-active (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element; ≥3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile navigation drawer.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, counters, keyboard hints, sidebar group labels.
styles.sample: กำลังประมวลผล

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs, menu items.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Temporary passwords, IDs, file extensions, audit payloads.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudge, hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips, between icon and caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons; dense list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input inner padding (x), menu item padding, card gaps in dense grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), gap between form fields, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Composer padding, toast padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding (desktop), gap between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above page title, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing around the new-chat greeting.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Login panel padding (desktop).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, citation marker, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, tooltips, file-type tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, toasts, message bubbles, table container.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer and dialogs — the largest radius in the corporate system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle switch, avatars, status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons (secondary), cards on surface-subtle.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Composer, menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile drawer.

breakpoint.note: Min-width breakpoints. Below bp-md the app shell switches to the mobile top bar + drawer.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-column format cards in Create files.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Desktop shell starts (sidebar visible). Same value as the current code.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Sidebar at full width-sidebar; Knowledge table shows all columns.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Content max-width kicks in; extra space becomes margin.

layout.note: Fixed layout dimensions used by the app shell.

tokens.name: width-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar ≥ bp-lg.

tokens.name: width-sidebar-compact
tokens.usage: Sidebar between bp-md and bp-lg.

tokens.name: width-chat
tokens.usage: Max width of transcript and composer.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Max width of Knowledge, Create files, Organization, Settings.

tokens.name: height-header
tokens.usage: Desktop header bar and mobile top bar.

tokens.name: height-control
tokens.usage: Default button / input height (md). sm = 32px, lg = 48px.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile.

duration.note: Motion durations. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop to 0ms except progress indicators.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tab indicator.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawer, toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for entering and moving elements.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving (menus closing, toasts dismissing).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky header, composer dock.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile navigation drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the + menu.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always on top.
